entities.summary: Dmytro Serhiiovych Krasylnykov is a Ukrainian brigadier general, who served as the commander of the Northern Operational Command from 2023 until his dismissal in 2025, and commander of the Pivnich operational-strategic group. He is a Hero of Ukraine (2022).
